title: Taylor Swift Cheers Wildly at Travis Kelce's Celebration at Arrowhead
seoTitle: Taylor Swift Celebrates Travis Kelce's Touchdown
subtitle: The pop star made a fuss by pointing to her wedding ring during the match against the Indianapolis Colts
excerpt: Taylor Swift, joined by her family, celebrated Travis Kelce's first touchdown of the 2026 season by pointing to her wedding ring, showing support for her husband.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Travis Kelce's first touchdown of the 2026 season, scored against the Indianapolis Colts, gained attention as it was celebrated by Taylor Swift, who pointed to her wedding ring and shouted, “That’s my husband!”. The moment was broadcast live and quickly generated a major reaction among football and music fans.

The Celebration at Arrowhead Stadium

During the first quarter of the match between the Kansas City Chiefs and the Indianapolis Colts, Travis Kelce received the ball after a turnover and ran into the end zone, scoring his first touchdown of the season. The play followed a pattern already familiar to NFL fans, but the crowd's reaction was different.

Taylor Swift's Role as a Wife

Taylor Swift was in the luxury suite alongside her husband, mother, and father, wearing a red Chiefs tank top and dark blue jeans. When Kelce scored, the singer pointed to the wedding ring she was wearing and exclaimed, “That’s my husband!”. The gesture was captured by NBC's broadcast, which showed the pop star celebrating alongside her partner.

Wedding Details

The couple officially tied the knot in a ceremony at Madison Square Garden in July of this year, with Adam Sandler officiating. The reception featured appearances by celebrities such as Gigi Hadid, Selena Gomez, Tom Cruise, Karlie Kloss, and Ethan Hawke.

Impact on the Chiefs' Season

In addition to the personal celebration, Kelce's touchdown helped the Chiefs solidify their victory over the Colts. The team won 31-10, keeping the defense focused on the tight end, who already boasts 11 Pro Bowl selections and three Super Bowl titles. In the previous game against the Denver Broncos, Kelce recorded three receptions for 71 yards.

Repercussion of the Moment

The episode reinforced Swift's constant presence at Chiefs games since the couple began dating nearly three years ago, when she attended the matchup against the Chicago Bears. The image of the singer pointing to her ring has become a symbol of the partnership between pop music and American football in the United States.

With information from Fox News, Yahoo.
